Reactions may occur at the site of application and are usually mild or moderate in intensity. The site should be rotated on a daily basis and the same site should not be used within 14 days. Licensed product information recommends that rotigotine should be used with caution in patients with severe hepatic im- pairment and reduced doses may be necessary in cases of wors- ening impairment; however, this is based on a lack of evidence in such patients.
